name: too-many-problems
text: I have an appointment coming up, my phone is almost dead, and I still have not opened a letter from housing. Help me sort out what matters first.

name: appeal-benefits
text: I am deciding whether to appeal a Basic Food benefits cutoff letter or reapply. The letter says my eligibility is ending because proof of income is missing. Help me think through what information matters.

name: payment-plan
text: I owe $780 on an old utility bill and they offered a payment plan of $65 a month. Help me think through the money pieces I should verify.

name: court-letter
text: I have an eviction summons with an answer date and a court hearing, and I keep avoiding it. Help me think through the legal steps and deadlines I need to identify before I respond.

name: friend-conflict
text: I am upset at a friend who keeps cancelling plans. Help me think through whether to say something or let it go.
